<strong>Windows 10超简单的免费激活方法：</strong><br>

<font face="Simsun">输入（powershell） 回车</font><br>
<font face="Simsun">复制粘贴（irm </font><font face="Simsun"><font style="font-size:14px"><a rel="nofollow noopener" href="https://massgrave.dev/get" target="_blank"><font style="color:rgb(51, 51, 51)"><font face="&amp;quot">https://massgrave.dev/get</font></font></a></font></font><font face="Simsun"> | iex）回车</font><br>
